steps.label: compile checks
cmd: out=$(g++ -std=c++17 -g -O1 -fno-omit-frame-pointer -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=undefined -Iinclude src/*.cpp __checker__/check.cpp -o chk 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -E '^(src|include)/[^ ]*:[0-9]+:[0-9]+: (fatal )?error'; echo 'the hidden checks do not compile against this library: keep the API of include/sparse/*.hpp (README.md)'; exit 1; }
